court: In the High Court of Madras†

prayer: PRAYER: Contempt Petition is filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, praying to punish the respondent herein for his willful disobedience of the order passed by this Court in W.P.(MD) No. 24427 of 2018, dated 12.12.2018.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.S. Sundar, J.:— The learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondent on instructions stated that the order of this Court has been complied with and an order is also passed in the appeal on 16.09.2019.

2. Recording compliance, this Contempt Petition is closed. No costs.
